title: Check and checkmate
info: Check means the king is attacked. The player in check must answer it on the next move.
Checkmate means the king is in check and there is no legal way out. That ends the game.

questions.q: When your king is in check you must
options: get out of check on that move
turn the king into a pawn
the king is safe but bored
the king is attacked and has no way out

questions.q: Ways out of check can include
options: moving the king, capturing the attacker, or blocking
it is the same as checkmate
the king is not in check, but there is no legal move, so it is a draw
